design: Bin the M7 assemblies of the pilot and the hard benchmark with `meta-co-assembler bin`: MetaBAT 2 with strobealign --aemb and with minimap2 coverage on every assembly, SemiBin2 with strobealign on every assembly, and SemiBin2 with minimap2 on the pooled discovery coassembly. Coverage comes from every sample of the run: discovery pools for the coassembly, original reads for all-read assemblies. CheckM2 quality, skani dereplication at 99% ANI, and a skani catalogue comparison at 95% ANI over half of the bin. Each run used 16 threads / 64 GiB under /usr/bin/time; runs within a dataset were serial and the two datasets ran concurrently on one 64-CPU node.

assemblies.discovery-pooled: discovery pools, all samples pooled (coverage from pools)
assemblies.allreads-pooled: all reads, all samples pooled (coverage from all reads)
assemblies.allreads-grouped: all reads, one assembly per community (coverage from all reads)

evaluation_notes: Truth from scripts/evaluate_bins.py: bin contigs aligned to every source genome with minimap2 asm10; a contig belongs to the genome with most matches covering half of it. Purity is the dominant genome's share of the bin; true completeness is the dominant genome covered by the bin; true contamination is foreign bases as a percentage of the dominant genome (CheckM scale). Quality tiers use CheckM2 or true values with the MIMAG completeness/contamination thresholds only. Held-out genomes have no catalogued species relative.

metabat2.binner: MetaBAT: Metagenome Binning based on Abundance and Tetranucleotide frequency (version 2:2.18; 20260408_021740)

pilot.description: M1 pilot: 8 samples x 1M pairs, 2 communities, species-holdout catalogue (2 held-out genomes)

hard.description: M7 hard benchmark: 12 samples x 500k pairs, 3 communities, 8 novel genomes (congeners, thin, rare, common)
